dex.entry: A lithe glowing fern-serpent native to Lowleaf Hollow's bioluminescent undergrowth. Its body traces the pattern of fern fronds, and it darts through the dark emitting soft cyan pulses. Canon atlas kin — the glowing fern-serpent, fast and magical.

art.silhouette: Slender vine-serpent body, fern-leaf pattern along its sides that glows cyan, bright curious eyes, small frond-crown on its head; sinuous and quick.
art.palette: Slender vine-serpent body, fern-leaf pattern along its sides that glows cyan, bright curious eyes, small frond-crown on its head; sinuous and quick.
art.direction: Canon atlas kin — the glowing fern-serpent, fast and magical. Hits Verdant/Light coverage and doubles as a moving lantern.
